capability.evidence_class: DECISION_PLANE_DIAGNOSTIC (real bars, real taker fee; not engine fills, not a venue settlement)
capability.provenance: replayed from the real tape with the swing family primitives; series cross-checked against the frozen NX06 receipt

warmup_declared_vs_replayed.finding: the NX06 harness replays with a hardcoded warmup; the declared table in economics/grammar.py is the pre-registered value. Replaying the declared value does not change the campaign count but moves the net sum by ~1e-6, so the two must be aligned before the next freeze.

prospective_maturity.note: no cadence has elapsed; the frozen window has not been observed yet

economic_readiness.formula: authority preconditions met / authority preconditions required
economic_readiness.provenance: each condition read from its own evidence artifact; unmet stays unmet

gate_coverage.formula: gates PASS / ten hard gates, resolved on the same series as capability

non_authority: these percentages audit measured state; none of them grants readiness, a claim, or capital authority, and none of them is a forecast

technical_delivery.formula: issues with a passing re-run in the matrix / issues registered in the matrix
technical_delivery.provenance: counted from the acceptance matrix and the issue reports on disk; no total is hardcoded
